name: Frank F'alzone
desc: Frank F'alzone, is a Celtor NPC who was part of [Captain Orlandeau's](entity:capn_orlandeau) crew in [The Scoundrel's Bounty](location:the_scoundrels_bounty). They were the crew's cartographer and janitor.
additional_info: -   F'alzone's racial variant appears to be Marten.
